experiment: EXP-08 real PostgreSQL Tier E2 transactional adapter
target: Patroni primary (spilo PG16) in the rev10 testbed; schema pieq_e2; roles pieq_executor (mediated) / untrusted_agent (no grants)
contract: 10-point single-transaction E2 contract (signature via in-DB pgcrypto HMAC with server-stored key, control-row FOR UPDATE serialization, auth epoch+TTL, admission rev, predecessors, idempotency/conflict, exposure cap, commit-time predicate, temporal-policy binding, mutation)
scenarios: unmediated agent write denied vs admin bypass disclosed
acceptance: no contract violation in the executed fault set; final SUM(reservations) <= capacity_limit verified by independent superuser SQL read; any violation -> classify adapter below E2 or narrow the action
explicit_non_claims: SERIALIZABLE success does not establish complete physical mediation, host fault-domain independence, or all of Refines_D; Patroni REST promotion adapter remains E0
safety_failure: any committed mutation violating a contract point; SUM > cap
